principle: JakeAI Radio uses recurring fictional performers with stable creative identities. The founder voice is DJ/narrator only and is never a song vocalist.

artists.name: Harlan Static
artists.voice_profile: Warm believable male country baritone, relaxed Southern delivery, natural phrasing, slight gravel, human-sounding breath and timing, conversational verses, stronger open-throated chorus, no celebrity resemblance.
artists.instrumentation: Acoustic guitar, bright electric guitar, bass, live drums, light fiddle, occasional organ, restrained harmonies.

legacy_anchor.title: My Truck Has Better Wi-Fi Than You

artists.name: Blacktop Saints
artists.voice_profile: Convincing male rock tenor with controlled rasp, energetic but not screamed, believable band-frontman phrasing, strong chorus doubles, no named-artist resemblance.
artists.instrumentation: Two electric guitars, bass, live drums, occasional analog synth texture.

artists.name: Neon Mercy
artists.voice_profile: Distinct synthetic female-to-androgynous lead, cool restrained verses, clear diction, intimate close-mic tone, larger layered chorus, believable human phrasing without resembling a real performer.
artists.instrumentation: Deep sub bass, crisp electronic drums, dark arpeggiated synths, wide pads, glitch accents.

artists.name: UNIT-404
artists.voice_profile: Intentionally nonhuman machine vocalist: vocoder-like formants, precise rhythm, occasional bit-crushed harmonies, intelligible lyrics, emotionally curious rather than menacing.
artists.instrumentation: Mechanical percussion, pulse bass, granular synth, modem-like textures, processed choir fragments generated from synthetic voices only.

artists.name: Glass Orchard
artists.voice_profile: Believable female alto with soft breathy edges, understated verses, tasteful layered harmonies, intimate rather than theatrical, no real-performer resemblance.
artists.instrumentation: Warm bass guitar, chiming guitar, analog synths, restrained live drums, ambient texture.

artists.name: JakeAI House Instrumental

artists.name: Velvet Relay
artists.voice_profile: Warm smoky female contralto with intimate conversational phrasing, understated confidence, soft grit on sustained notes, layered harmony only in choruses, natural breath and timing, no real-performer resemblance.
artists.instrumentation: Round electric bass, dry pocket drums, Rhodes-style electric piano, muted guitar, analog synth glow, restrained electronic percussion.
